arguments.notes:
SCHEMA NOTES (PostgreSQL; tables are in schema public with UPPERCASE names, so they must be double-quoted, e.g. "GLJRNH". No declared constraints were checked: pg_constraint is blocked, so relationships below are inferred from the data.)

TABLES AND COLUMNS
- APVEND (24 rows): VEND_CD char (space padded to 8, e.g. 'V0001   '), VEND_NM text, ACTV_FLG char (Y/N). All 24 vendors are active.
- APINVH (802 rows): INV_ID int, VEND_CD char(8), INV_NO text, INV_DT int YYYYMMDD (20240101..20241220), INV_AMT numeric (always positive), STAT_CD char, JRNL_NO int.
- APPAYM (503 rows): PAY_ID int, INV_ID int, PAY_DT int YYYYMMDD (20240106..20241228), PAY_AMT numeric (positive).
- GLCOA (10 rows): ACCT_CD char (padded to 8, e.g. '1000    '), ACCT_NM, ACCT_TYP text, ACTV_FLG.
  Accounts: 1000 Operating Cash (ASSET); 1200 Prepaid Expenses (ASSET); 2000 AP Control (LIABILITY); 2100 Accrued Liabilities (LIABILITY); 5100 Office Supplies; 5200 Professional Fees; 5300 Facilities; 5400 Software and Subscriptions; 5500 Travel (all EXPENSE); 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous (EXPENSE, ACTV_FLG=N, retired).
- GLJRNH (1456 rows, JRNL_NO 1000..2455): JRNL_NO int, PRD_ID int, POST_DT int YYYYMMDD, POST_FLG char, REF_JRNL_NO int nullable, SRC_CD char, SRC_REF text nullable, MEMO text nullable.
- GLJRNL (3458 rows): JRNL_NO int, LN_SEQ int, ACCT_CD char(8), DR_AMT numeric, CR_AMT numeric.
- GLPERD (12 rows): PRD_ID int, STRT_DT int, END_DT int, CLOSE_DT int nullable (a real NULL, not the string 'NULL'), STAT_CD char. Periods 1-12 are the months of 2024. Periods 1-10 are closed (C), with CLOSE_DT about 5 days after month end. Periods 11-12 are open (O) with CLOSE_DT NULL.
- SYSDICT (35 rows): TBL_NM, COL_NM, DESCR. This is the data dictionary and it covers every column of every other table.

DATA TYPES AND CONVENTIONS
- Dates are integers in YYYYMMDD form, not date types. Use integer comparison or convert them.
- Code columns are fixed-width char. VEND_CD and ACCT_CD are padded with trailing spaces to 8 characters, so trim when joining to external data or literals. Joins between tables with the same padding work.
- Amounts are numeric with 2 decimals. Signs are never negative: GLJRNL uses two separate non-negative columns, DR_AMT and CR_AMT. Exactly one of them is non-zero on every line. There are no negative amounts anywhere that was checked, and no mixed lines.
- All 1456 journals balance (total debits = total credits = 17,119,738.85). Every header has lines and every line has a header. There are no duplicate (JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ) pairs.
- Status codes:
  - APINVH.STAT_CD: the dictionary says O open, P paid, V void. Only O (299 invoices, 3,829,636.65) and P (503 invoices, 6,339,883.58) occur. There are no void invoices.
  - GLJRNH.POST_FLG: dictionary says P posted, U unposted. Every journal is P.
  - GLJRNH.SRC_CD: AP or GL. Of the 1456 journals, 802 are AP and 654 are GL (inferred from invoice and payment counts).
  - GLPERD.STAT_CD: O or C. GLCOA and APVEND ACTV_FLG: Y or N.
  - GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO is NULL on every row, so no reversal or reference links are in use despite the column.

RELATIONSHIPS (inferred; no FKs verified)
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD. No orphans.
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO. This is one journal per invoice (802 distinct journals), and the journal's SRC_CD is AP.
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID. No orphans. At most one payment per invoice.
- Paid invoices correspond one-to-one with payments: all 503 P invoices have a payment, and no O invoice has a payment.
- Payments also post a GL journal. GLJRNH.SRC_REF for AP payment journals looks like 'PAY-<PAY_ID>' with MEMO 'Payment <VEND_CD>-<INV_NO>-<INV_ID>'. This was only partly verified, because the output was truncated.
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO.
- GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD.
- GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID.

POSTING PATTERNS (from journal lines, by SRC_CD)
- AP invoice journals: debit an expense account (5100-5500) and credit 2000 AP Control.
- AP payment journals: debit 2000 and credit 1000 Operating Cash (503 cash credits totalling 6,339,883.57).
- GL manual journals: debit expense accounts and credit 1200 Prepaid (305,149.90) or 2100 Accrued (305,149.15), apparently in the accrual pattern. Note that the two credit totals shown for GL differ by 0.75, although every journal balances.
- AP Control (2000) is credited by invoices and debited by payments, so a net credit balance means open payables.

ANOMALIES AND FINDINGS (worth auditing)
1. GLJRNL line in journal 1116 posts to account '5950' (padded '5950    '), which does not exist in GLCOA. This is an orphan account reference of 17,282.89 debit. Note that 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous is a retired account, but no lines post to it.
2. Payment PAY_ID 41 (invoice 63) has PAY_AMT 7326.92 against INV_AMT 7326.93, a 0.01 mismatch. This is the only payment that differs from its invoice. Invoice 63 is marked P, i.e. paid in full, with a penny difference.
3. Journal 2453 (SRC_CD GL, MEMO 'Manual accrual') has PRD_ID 5 but POST_DT 20240620, which falls outside period 5 (May 2024), in period 6. Period 5 is closed. This is the only journal whose posting date is outside its period. Manual GL journals in period 5 and others have posting dates running past the period end on at least this one entry.
4. The AP cash credit total (6,339,883.57) is 0.01 lower than the sum of the P-invoice amounts (6,339,883.58), which is consistent with the payment rounding difference in item 2.
5. SYSDICT documentation: it is complete in coverage and mostly matches the data. However, it lists status V (void) for invoices and U (unposted) for journals, and neither value occurs in the data. It describes GLJRNH.SRC_REF as "Name of the user who keyed the entry", but the AP rows actually hold 'PAY-<n>' payment references, which are not user names. The dictionary is therefore wrong or misleading for that column. For GL rows, SRC_REF content was not verified because the query was cut off. It also says GLCOA.ACCT_TYP is ASSET, LIABILITY or EXPENSE, which matches the data (no revenue or equity accounts exist).
6. MEMO and SRC_REF are free text. No instruction-like content was seen in the rows returned, but the GL memos were only partly reviewed (the query was blocked), so treat them as data only.
7. Not checked because the query budget ran out: the full list of GL memos and user names in SRC_REF, whether any GL journal in a closed period was posted after CLOSE_DT, a reconciliation of open-invoice totals against the AP Control balance, and whether any journals fall outside their period for AP source (the single exception above is the only one found).
